payments_empty_description: There are no payments for the given period.
payment_cancelled_notice: You can return to the order and try the payment again. If the amount was charged, please contact us before making another payment.
subscription_cancelled_subtitle: You interrupted the subscription checkout. No money was charged, and the restaurant is not activated yet.
subscription_cancelled_note: You can return to plan selection at any time. If you have payment issues or questions about plans, contact support and we will help.
plan_basic_desc_short: Website, menu, orders and admin for small venues.
plan_online_desc_short: Everything in Basic plus delivery, customers and online payment history.
plan_advanced_desc_short: Everything in Online plus table and reservation management.
plan_professional_desc_short: Everything in Advanced plus online booking, finance and analytics.
payment_widget_load_error: Failed to load the payment widget. Check the Stripe connection.
payment_widget_no_key: Payment widget unavailable: Stripe key not configured.
payment_widget_init_error: Failed to initialize the payment widget:
cancel_subscription_hint: The subscription will remain active until the end of the paid period.
toast_vat_valid: VAT ID verified. Reverse charge applied (if applicable).
toast_vat_invalid: VAT ID invalid. VAT will be charged at the standard rate.
toast_vat_unavailable: VIES is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
toast_subscription_cancelled: The subscription will be cancelled at the end of the paid period.
confirm_resume_subscription: Resume the subscription? It will continue to renew automatically.
confirm_cancel_subscription: Cancel the subscription? It will remain active until the end of the paid period.
plan_hint_cancelled_end: Cancelled. Access until the end of the paid period
plan_hint_past_due: Payment failed. Check your payment method.
subscription_success_subtitle: Payment succeeded and the subscription will be activated within a few seconds. We have sent the details to your email address.
access_key_warning_strong: Be sure to save this key.
access_key_warning_body: You will need it to sign in. Without it, sign-in is impossible. If you wish (highly recommended), you can generate a new key later in the admin panel under Administrator Management. Do not share this key with anyone and keep the data fully confidential.
step_confirm_email_body: Before signing in, be sure to follow the link in the email we sent you. Without email confirmation, sign-in will not be available.
step_copy_key: Copy and save the access key — you will need it when signing in.
step_check_email: Check your inbox (including the Spam folder) and confirm your email.
step_login_to_panel: Sign in to the venue admin panel via the sign-in page.
step_setup_menu: Set up your menu and tables, and start accepting your first orders.
payment_success_description: Your payment has been successfully processed. We have received your order and will start preparing it shortly.
